_meta.purpose: The fifth Daily-5 post: useful, conversion-aware poll/conversation prompts. Not memes, not lightweight fun-bank content, not generic engagement filler. Each post should create a reason to save, vote, comment, compare options, or take one clear action on Internwise.
rules: No recycled fun/meme formats from the old plan.
Each prompt must be useful even if nobody comments or votes.
Use poll-like choices, decision prompts, this-or-that comparisons, or comment prompts tied to a useful takeaway.
Every post carries a clear Internwise next step.
